✦ what I actually want to say ✦

A letter.
No edits.

APR 25
2026
★
JAIPUR
hey,

Gungun —

I don't really know how to write this without it sounding like something from a birthday card (i dont even know how to write ). So I'm just going to say it the way I'd say it to you in person — probably a little awkward(eesa kuch nhi hota), probably a little honest, but real.

You know everything about me. And I mean everything. The stuff I'd never tell anyone else, the 2am spiral thoughts, my opinions You still showed up. Every time. That's not nothing. That's actually everything.

I've had friends(not much), but I haven't had many people who just — get it. You get it. You get me. You knew when to push and when to just sit there. You knew when I needed honesty and when I needed someone to be on my side even when I was not meeing, IDK How did you figure all that out?

We've done so much stupid, beautiful stuff together. The kind of stuff that doesn't really make sense unless you were there. And I was always glad I was there. Every single time.

I annoyed u , irritated u alot (thats all what i do ) , but i never left me (i guess ). I hope you know that. I hope on this birthday, you feel even a fraction of what you've made me feel — which is: lucky. Just really, genuinely lucky to know you.

Here's to 23 (old hag). I hope it's everything you want it to be. I hope it's full of the kind of moments we'll be talking about years from now. I hope you get soft-served ice cream , cheez-corn pizza , kit-kat shake on a random Tuesday and it makes your whole day. I hope people are as good to you as you are to them.

You deserve good things, Gungun. Quietly, loudly, in every direction.

always in your heart's(& home's ) corner,
Aryan. ✦
✦ exhibit A through F ✦

a field guide to
Gungun.

documented over years of firsthand suffering. peer-reviewed by me.
01 /

The Menu Is Just A Formality

Cheez doen pizza. Every single time. Doesn't matter if we're at a new place, a fancy place, a place that clearly doesn't specialise in pizza. Cheez doen pizza. The waiter doesn't even need to come over anymore.

predictable ✓
02 /

The KitKat Shake Agenda

Is it a drink? Is it a dessert? Does it matter? No. It is the answer. It is always the answer. I don't think she's ever ordered any other shake in her life and honestly I respect the commitment.

no notes 🥤
03 /

Gupchup. Not Pani Puri. Not Puchka. GUPCHUP.

She will walk 1 km. In summer. In Rajasthan. In the kind of heat that makes you question your life choices. All for gupchup. And she will not call them anything else. She has opinions about the name. I've heard the speech. Multiple times.

unhinged 🌶️
04 /

The Bus Hostage Situation

I got free. I could have left. I was free, Gungun. But no — I waited. Because her bus hadn't gone yet. Because apparently that's just what you do now. I have sat in that college doing absolutely nothing for what adds up to probably several full days of my life.

worth it tho 🚌
05 /

She Shows Up When Called

Every time I said "come to college" — she came. No complaints, no negotiations, no "ugh really?" Just showed up. I'm not entirely sure I deserve this. I know I don't. But she did it anyway.

certified ✦ loyal
06 /

The Lunch Thing (This One's Actually Sweet)

She brought me lunch. Every day. Sometimes she made it herself. Let that sink in. She cooked. For me. Every day. I don't know what I did to deserve this. I also don't think I should examine it too closely or the magic might disappear.

homecooked 🍱
07 /

The Slap. (Recurring. Documented.)

I say something. She processes it. A brief pause. Slap. I genuinely do not know how many times this has happened. I know I "irritate her." I know this because she tells me — usually with her hand. At this point it's basically a love language.

✋ classic
